Admin routes of the seo module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/seo/analytics

Get Google Search Console analytics rollup

Parameters:

- `range` in query (`"28d"`, `"7d"`, `"90d"`, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description. Body: object.

## GET /v1/admin/seo/coverage

Get per-engine sitemap coverage

Responses:

- `200`: no description. Body: object.

## GET /v1/admin/seo/health

Get SEO health check report

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## POST /v1/admin/seo/health/recheck

Re-check live search engine submission health

Responses:

- `200`: no description. Body: object.

## GET /v1/admin/seo/quota

Get search engine submission quota readout

Responses:

- `200`: no description. Body: object.

## GET /v1/admin/seo/redirects

List SEO redirects

Parameters:

- `isAutoGenerated` in query (boolean, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `search` in query (string, optional).
- `sortBy` in query (`"createdAt"`, `"fromPath"`, `"updatedAt"`, optional).
- `sortOrder` in query (`"asc"`, `"desc"`, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## POST /v1/admin/seo/redirects

Create new SEO redirect

Request body: [CreateRedirectAdminDto](#createredirectadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: no description.

## DELETE /v1/admin/seo/redirects/{id}

Delete SEO redirect

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: no description.

## GET /v1/admin/seo/submissions

List search engine submission history

Parameters:

- `accepted` in query (boolean, optional).
- `engine` in query (`"bing"`, `"gsc"`, `"indexnow"`, optional).
- `from` in query (string, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `sortBy` in query (`"createdAt"`, optional).
- `sortOrder` in query (`"asc"`, `"desc"`, optional).
- `targetType` in query (`"products"`, `"sitemap"`, `"url"`, optional).
- `to` in query (string, optional).
- `trigger` in query (`"auto-regen"`, `"cron"`, `"manual"`, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## POST /v1/admin/seo/submit

Submit URLs or sitemap to search engines for reindexing

Request body: [SubmitSeoAdminDto](#submitseoadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: no description. Body: object.

## GET /v1/admin/seo/url-inspection

Get Google index state for one URL

Parameters:

- `locale` in query (`"ar"`, `"en"`, `"fr"`, optional).
- `productId` in query (string, optional).
- `url` in query (string, uri, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description. Body: object.

## Schemas

### CreateRedirectAdminDto

- `fromPath` (string, required).
- `toPath` (string, required).
- `type` (`"FOUND"`, `"MOVED_PERMANENTLY"`, optional).

### SubmitSeoAdminDto

- `url` (string, uri, optional).
- `productIds` (array of string, optional).
- `sitemap` (boolean, optional).
- `engines` (array of `"bing"`, `"gsc"`, `"indexnow"`, optional).
- `dryRun` (boolean, optional).
